_doc: A2.9/A2.9a: diario de Dex, capítulo 2 (lobby, upstairs, rooftop). A3.4a: Penny y el abrigo (p2_coat, notas de Penny); el resto se reescribe en A3.4b-d. Ver qa/README.md § Diario.

goals.text: Get Adrian's keycard out of his coat. Past Penny.
Find out what's blinking down below.

notes.text: Penny guards Adrian's coat. She doesn't read other people's mail. Unless it's marked confidential.
Adrian's coat: an admin keycard with his face on it, and a Mt. Gox pen that won't stop leaking. Penny never saw a thing.
Penny panicked at 'Patient Zero'. 'Basement-level clearance.' Something downstairs keeps blinking. Noted. Underlined.
Read all 38 pages of Adrian's Terms. Prize: a trading terminal key and a sticky note, 'PZ escaped via contract exploit. Check server logs.'
The weather vane on the roof works a latch on the service hatch. Who wires a weather vane to a hatch? Adrian.
That blinking below the building is a server heartbeat. Something in the basement is still running.

hints: Gatekeepers can't resist a good secret. Give her something to read.
Penny reads anything marked confidential. You've got an envelope that says exactly that.
Put the confidential envelope on Penny's desk. While she reads, take the coat.
Upstairs, a drawer wants you to do the one thing nobody ever does.
It's a Terms and Conditions lock. Don't accept. Read.
Use the trading desk upstairs and pick 'Keep reading' until page 38.
Go up. Things on roofs point somewhere.
The weather vane is wired to something.
Use the weather vane. Force it down.
Something down there is blinking at you.
The light at the bottom of the building.
From the roof, look at the basement light.
